title: Chapter 622
text:
There was no suspense in the battle of annihilation. Bredt's troops were completely annihilated, and the battlefield became deathly silent.

Han Xiao cooperated with Jayne and Gadeli's troops, piloting the third generation Ship Destroyer and cutting through the enemy fleet. The enemy fleet did not have the slightest ability to fight back. He now had two methods of galactic warfare. Virtual Intrusion was tricky, and piloting the Giant Soldier was simple and crude.

With such small fries, there was no need for him to go through the trouble of invading. It was best to just cut them down.

Han Xiao had seen thousands of battleships firing at each other in his previous life, and he had even participated in the battle personally. Compared to the density of cannon fire in a large-scale galactic battle, this small scale battle did not give him any pressure at all. He did not find it difficult to dodge the attacks at all.

The performance of the third generation Ship Destroyer was also one of the reasons. Han Xiao had spent a lot of effort perfecting the blueprint of this Giant Soldier mechanical suit. God knew how many functions it had, and it would be of the greatest use in this kind of small-scale galactic battle. Building the third generation Ship Destroyer cost more than 3.5 million Enas, which was much more expensive than some of the high-grade small battleships. If it was two years ago, this amount of money would have made his heart ache.

But now, it was only average at most.

The ability of the Black Star Corps to earn money could even beat Floating Dragon Island. Han Xiao vaguely remembered that the last time he checked his account balance, he seemed to have more than eighty million Enas in liquid funds, and his fixed assets were a few times that amount. Although this was far from a commercial financial group, he was still a young and promising leek scholar … er, no, a leader of an organization.

Originally, Jayne and Gadeli's troops were the main attackers, but once Han Xiao joined the battle, he immediately took over their position and dominated the battle. They could only help Han Xiao contain the enemy. After watching the entire battle, they had a deep impression of Han Xiao's style of piloting the Giant Soldier. In summary …

Flirtatious!

Luxurious!

Naughty!

The third generation Ship Destroyer also suffered some damage. In just a short battle, a large amount of fuel was burned. Han Xiao recalled the third generation Ship Destroyer and returned to Risda's body to meet up with Jayne and Gadeli. The three of them left the scene of the crime and headed to the nearest uninhabited planet to rest.

"You guys did a great job." Dottle contacted the three of them and praised them.

The rewards were transferred to everyone's accounts, and Han Xiao's mission was completed. The Faction Favorability of the Amethyst Civilization increased slightly.

"I'm sure everyone has their own guesses. That's right, this is a simple test. We're going to select some reliable non-official forces to work with. You've all displayed your strength, so I hope we can have a pleasant cooperation in the future."

Jayne and Gadeli were overjoyed. They thought that Black Star had stolen all the limelight and that they would not have a chance to work together. Now, they were pleasantly surprised.

Dottle explained to them:

"Everyone has experienced the chaos in the Shattered Star Ring in the past two years. The situation in the future will be even more complicated and dangerous. We are secretly expanding our armed forces and looking for more partners like you to protect the safety of the Colton Star Cluster. I can't tell you the details, but I can tell you something. The higher-ups are preparing to form a new secret force, and you are all candidates. "

Forming a secret force?

Han Xiao immediately perked up. He knew which part of the storyline this was.

During the Crimson Tide in Version 3.0, due to the chaos, forming a group had become a trend. Not only the Amethyst Civilization, but many Star Cluster Civilizations had secretly gathered armed forces in their territories to protect the security of their territories and formed a secret organization like a guardian.

For example, the Shattered Star Ring Mercenary Alliance in Version 3.0 was a product of mercenaries forming a group.

These groups were the factions that the players in Han Xiao's previous life could choose in Version 3.0.

Han Xiao remembered that the organization formed by the Amethyst Civilization was called 'Section Zero', which meant that it was the hidden department of the Amethyst Civilization. The members were all experts and organizations from various Star Systems in the Colton Star Cluster. They would accept the long-term employment of the Amethyst Civilization and become partners with the Purple Crystal Army.

In other words, Jayne and Gadeli would be his teammates in the future.

Han Xiao would not reject such a good opportunity. Not to mention that the Cutting-Edge Knowledge would still be in the hands of the Amethyst Civilization, just becoming a member of Section Zero was a good thing in itself. It was an opportunity to build a relationship with a Star Cluster Civilization in the long term.

In his previous life, when the players entered Version 3.0, these organizations had already been formed. What the players saw was the result of the organization taking shape. However, what was in front of Han Xiao now was the embryonic stage of the organization's preparation. This was undoubtedly a better opportunity.

He did not even need to recommend himself. The Amethyst Civilization had already taken a liking to him. His current position could not be separated from his hard work and the efforts of the players.

If he could become the main force of Section Zero, it would be equivalent to making a name for himself in the Shattered Star Ring. His reputation and status would increase greatly, and he would become a first-rate organization in the Colton Star Cluster.

This was a shortcut for him to develop to a higher level!

"If the remuneration is sufficient, I'm more than willing," Han Xiao replied.

Jayne and Gadeli also regained their senses and responded, expressing that they were more than willing to join the secret organization that the Amethyst Civilization was about to form.

"The remuneration will not disappoint you. The organization is still in the process of selection. When it is officially formed, we will have a large number of missions," Dottel said.

"We will have a mission soon.

The Amethyst Civilization's move was equivalent to a global conscription. Originally, the Amethyst Civilization also had a few organizations that they were working with. However, in the past two years, Klent had been very restless. The Amethyst Civilization had a premonition that their conflict with the Klent Kingdom would become more and more intense. There was a high chance that a secret war would break out.

The so-called secret war would be when the government's army kept shouting 'come over here!' but they would not start a war no matter what. Instead, they would secretly use their collaborators to kill each other and cut off the other party's wings. This was a way of fighting under the restrictions of the 'Peace Treaty'. The ones fighting to the death were the collaborators.

Of course, the Star Cluster Civilizations knew that if they wanted the horse to run, they had to let the horse eat grass. Thus, they were very generous and gave their collaborators a large amount of resources. It could be said that as long as they could survive the secret war, the collaborators who were used as pawns would be able to soar into the sky.

Han Xiao understood the thinking of the Amethyst Civilization. It was impossible to develop without taking risks. Although he had a decent organization, it was impossible for him to grow too big. Han Xiao knew that he had to adjust his position at all times.

Unless Ames became a collaborator of Purple Crystal, he did not have enough bargaining chips when facing a Star Cluster Civilization. He had not reached the point where he could bargain with the Purple Crystal Civilization, and the Purple Crystal Civilization would not beg him to join. Instead, this was an opportunity for him to develop, and it was essentially a fair trade.

As long as the remuneration was sufficient, he did not mind fighting for the Amethyst Civilization. Now that he had the strength, he could boldly forge ahead.

Unlike Jayne and Gadeli, who were overjoyed, Han Xiao had already habitually started to deduce the consequences of his choice.

"The secret war …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin.

This was one of the main plots of Version 3.0. If one ignored the complicated interests behind the Crimson Tide, the main theme of Version 3.0 would be 'Chaotic War'!

Section Zero would fight with the many collaborators of the Klent Kingdom, and they would definitely not be able to avoid the Bloodshed Land.

As long as the Tyrant did not make a move, everything would be fine. He was not afraid of the other muscleheads at all. He had never been afraid of an opponent of the same level.

Xiu!

At this moment, the sound of a spaceship could be heard from the horizon. Han Xiao and the others stopped talking and looked up. A small and exquisite single-person spaceship had arrived on this planet without them knowing.

"Did they pass by to collect resources?" Jayne asked.

"I'm not sure." Gadeli shook his head.

The hatch of the single-person spaceship opened, and a woman wearing a white coat floated in midair. She wore a silver cat mask on her face and looked down at the group on the ground with a cold gaze.

"Who are you?"

Gadeli asked. Looking at this uninvited guest and feeling the powerful energy fluctuations in the woman's body, he could not help but be vigilant.

This was a Calamity Grade Super!

Shana ignored him and looked around. Her gaze landed on Han Xiao, and she asked calmly, "Black Star?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and did not answer. He could vaguely feel that she did not come with good intentions.

"It doesn't matter if you don't answer. You won't be able to escape today." Shana looked around and muttered to herself, "Three Calamity Grade Supers. That's a little difficult."

Ka ka ka!

The next moment, Shana made her move. From the moment she appeared to the moment she made her move, the entire process took less than ten seconds.

She reached out and clenched her fist. Half of the dozens of spaceships parked on the ground instantly disintegrated into metal fragments and exploded violently. Countless fragments turned into a metal storm. In just an instant, a portion of Jayne and Gadeli's subordinates were turned into minced meat.

Gadeli was furious. The battle suit on his body flowed like water, and nanoparticles gathered in his hand, turning into a shockingly large gun. Dozens of barrels fired at Shana at the same time. The explosive power was extremely strong, and the light cannons were all infused with his Mechanical Force.

Dong dong dong!

A sudden fierce battle broke out instantly!

Shana flicked her finger, and an invisible magnetic field appeared around her. Her defense was extremely strong, and the flames of the explosion covered her body. However, they were all blocked by the magnetic field, and she was not injured at all. Then, Shana clenched her fist.

Bang!

The huge cannon in Gadeli's hand instantly deflated and shattered, turning into nanoparticles all over the ground like a pile of sand.

"Metal control and magnetic field control?"

Han Xiao's expression froze. This uninvited guest was clearly here for him. Her ability was extremely effective against Mechanics, and he did not know where she came from. This attack came without any warning. All of a sudden, he had a flash of inspiration as he thought of that hunting list.

"No way, could it be so coincidental?"

Han Xiao was surprised. He was confused as to how this enemy knew that he was here.

He was acting alone, and other than the Amethyst Civilization, only Jayne and Gadeli could leak information …

No, there's another possibility!

Han Xiao suddenly thought of the fleet that he had just annihilated. They must have sent the information back before they were annihilated. Could it be that this group of hunters was related to Klent?

Hu hu!

Huge metal fragments whizzed toward him. This was not the time to think. Han Xiao was about to use Berserk Ape, but when he thought of the other party's Esper Ability, he frowned and had no choice but to give up on the idea of using the mechanical suit. He dodged with his own attributes and jumped far away.

The metal fragments created a huge crater on the ground with a loud bang, and debris flew everywhere.

Shana was single-handedly fighting everyone and multitasking. With just a few simple taps of her fingers, she destroyed the equipment on Gadeli's body. With a swing of her hand, she sent Gadeli flying far away. Jayne was shocked when he saw this. The combat power of this uninvited guest was beyond his expectations!

Han Xiao had a headache. Facing an opponent like this, Mechanics would definitely be restricted. Many of his methods would be easily nullified by the other party, and he would lose a lot of money.

This was the enemy whose ability was the most effective against him so far!

"Metal control is the nemesis of Mechanics. This woman's ability is probably at A + level. If this continues, the situation will not be good …"
